---
name: Feature or evidence gap
about: Propose a bounded change or identify a missing acceptance receipt
title: "[Proposal] "
---

## Operator task or evidence gap

Describe the concrete task or missing receipt. Link the relevant contract,
security-review control, roadmap item, or current source.

## Current status and proposed scope

Mark each relevant part as implemented, proposed, contract only, synthetic, or
native receipt required. Name the smallest candidate paths or workflow and any
new authority it would request.

## Acceptance evidence needed

List the exact environment, source/producer version, positive and negative
cases, failure behavior, privacy controls, and reviewer/operator decisions
needed. Keep units and source provenance explicit.

## What this would not establish

List host, sensor, platform, release, producer, or model claims that would
remain open even if the proposed work or its tests passed. Issue disposition
belongs to maintainers.
